calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Reliance
calls.summary: The conversation revolved around the early deployment of Growth Book’s free version in a development setting, highlighting potential infosec challenges related to SSO blocking enterprise readiness. Participants discussed the need for early infosec buy-in due to common objections when using the free tier. An enterprise trial was suggested to facilitate SSO use and ensure infosec approval. Resistance from infosec to external integrations and data access was noted, complicating full utilization. The pricing strategy was examined, emphasizing Growth Book's appeal at higher user phases. Additionally, the internal challenges a small team faces within a large organization were underscored, including high cost sensitivity and the need for precise experimentation and clear approvals.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SSO, InfoSec, enterprise trial, AB testing, feature flagging
